steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the penne until al dente, then reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
While the pasta cooks, mince the garlic and roughly chop the sun-dried tomatoes and basil.
Melt the butter in a wide skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and chili flakes; cook about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, then carefully add the vodka. Simmer 1–2 minutes to cook off the sharp alcohol edge.
Pour in the marinara and heavy cream. Simmer gently for 3–4 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Toss in the drained pasta, adding a splash of pasta water if needed so the sauce coats the noodles.
Finish with grated parmesan, black pepper, and torn basil. Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve.
Warm the taco shells in a low oven or dry skillet until crisp, then set aside.
Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.
Drain excess fat if needed, then stir in the taco seasoning with a splash of water. Simmer until thickened.
Fill each shell with seasoned beef, then top with shredded cheddar, salsa, and a dollop of sour cream.
Serve immediately while the shells are still crisp.
Rinse the rice, then cook it according to package directions until fluffy.
Warm the black beans in a saucepan; season lightly with salt and a squeeze of lime.
Heat the frozen corn in a skillet until hot and lightly browned at the edges.
Dice the avocado and cut remaining lime into wedges.
Build bowls with rice, beans, and corn. Top with salsa, avocado, and lime wedges.
Toast the bread slices until golden.
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Wilt the spinach for 1–2 minutes, then push to the side.
Crack in the eggs and cook to your preferred doneness (sunny-side up or lightly scrambled with the spinach).
Butter the toast if desired, pile on spinach and eggs, season with salt and pepper, and serve.
Cook the rice according to package directions.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet until cooked through and lightly browned; transfer to a plate.
In the same pan, stir-fry the broccoli with a splash of water until bright green and tender-crisp.
Return the chicken, add soy sauce, and toss to coat. Serve over rice.
Cook the udon noodles according to package directions; drain and rinse briefly if directed.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into cubes. Pan-sear until golden on a few sides.
Whisk the miso with a ladle of hot water until smooth, then warm gently (do not boil hard).
Combine noodles, tofu, and miso broth in bowls. Top with sliced green onions and serve.
Bring salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente; reserve a splash of pasta water, then drain.
Warm the marinara in a saucepan over medium-low heat until simmering.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, loosening with pasta water if needed.
Plate and finish with grated parmesan. Serve hot.
Whisk the pancake mix with the milk (and any package-directed liquid) until mostly smooth; a few small lumps are fine.
Cook pancakes on a lightly greased griddle over medium heat until bubbles form, then flip and finish.
In a separate pan, cook the eggs to your liking (fried or scrambled).
Serve pancakes with maple syrup alongside the eggs.
